memos.scout:
The honest case for buying is weak. The strongest signal is that the coin is alive and has real two-sided flow: 177 buyers against 200 sellers over the last 15 minutes, with net flow of +7.2 SOL and a +9.9% return in that window. Early buyer concentration looks moderate (top 3 hold 19.4% of the curve, top 5 buyers 18.2%), and graduation was fast at 5 seconds.

But the brief argues against demand persisting. The coin is 67% below its 30-minute high, the sell-to-buy ratio in the first two minutes after graduation was 0.96, and bundled buys make up 83.5% of curve activity, so much of the apparent volume may be coordinated rather than organic. A launch bot was present, and the pool is thin at 95 SOL. The name "Trumpcoin" borrows a famous ticker, which invites copycat and exit-liquidity dynamics.

I can't make a case that real demand will still be here in 30 to 60 minutes. My recommendation is to skip.
